rationales: The K shell is the first shell and holds a maximum of 2 electrons.
8 electrons is the maximum capacity of the L shell, not the K shell.
18 electrons is the maximum capacity of the M shell, not the K shell.
32 electrons is the maximum capacity of the N shell, not the K shell.
The third period has 8 elements, not 2.
The third period contains 8 elements.
The third period is not classified as a normal period in this terminology.
A very long period contains many more than 8 elements.
The second and third periods are called short periods.
Long periods refer to the fourth and fifth periods.
Normal periods is not the standard name for the second and third periods.
Very long periods refer to the sixth and seventh periods.
NaCl does not have metallic bonding between sodium and chlorine.
NaCl consists of ions rather than covalently shared electron pairs.
NaCl does not form a coordinate covalent bond.
Sodium transfers an electron to chlorine, forming an ionic bond.
Oxygen is an element, not a solution.
Carbon dioxide is a compound, not a solution.
Air is a homogeneous mixture of gases and is an example of a solution.
Nitrogen is an element, not a solution.
A homogeneous mixture of two or more substances is a solution.
A solvent is the substance that dissolves the solute, not the whole mixture.
A solute is the substance dissolved in a solvent.
Aqueous describes a solution whose solvent is water.
Saturated describes a solution containing the maximum dissolved solute, not specifically one made with water.
A solvent is the dissolving medium, not a solution formed in water.
A solute is the substance being dissolved.
A solution formed using water as the solvent is aqueous.
Gain of oxygen or loss of hydrogen defines oxidation.
Reduction generally involves loss of oxygen or gain of hydrogen.
Electricity is not the name of this chemical change.
An electrolyte conducts electricity in solution or when molten; it is not this process.
Groups are the vertical columns of the periodic table.
The horizontal rows of the periodic table are called periods.
Metals are a class of elements, not horizontal rows.
Non-metals are a class of elements, not horizontal rows.
Zinc is less reactive than sodium.
Tin is less reactive than sodium.
Lead is less reactive than sodium.
Sodium is a highly reactive alkali metal.
An atom is a particle of an element, not the general term for pure matter.
A pure form of matter is termed a substance.
A mixture contains more than one substance physically combined.
An element is a pure substance made of one kind of atom, but substance is the general term asked for.
8 electrons is the capacity of the L shell, not the N shell.
18 electrons is the capacity of the M shell, not the N shell.
The N shell has a maximum capacity of 32 electrons.
50 electrons is not the capacity of the N shell.
Iodine has lower electron affinity than chlorine, so it is not greater.
Iodine's larger atomic size means its electron affinity is less than chlorine's.
The electron affinities are not equal; chlorine's is greater.
Iodine's electron affinity is not negative in the usual school-level comparison.
Attractive forces are not the name for valence electrons involved in bonding.
Repulsive forces are not the name for valence electrons involved in bonding.
Valence electrons that participate in chemical bonds are called bonding electrons.
System energy is not the name for valence electrons involved in bonding.
An ion is a charged atom or group of atoms, not a non-bonded electron pair.
A single bond is a shared pair of electrons between atoms.
A non-bonded electron pair on an atom is called a lone pair.
A radical has an unpaired electron, not a non-bonded pair.
